# AccredReady

> AccredReady is NABH accreditation compliance software for Indian hospitals and healthcare organizations. It helps facilities prepare for NABH programmes — HCO Full Accreditation, SHCO Full Accreditation, HCO Entry Level Certification (ELC), SHCO Entry Level Certification (ELC), ECO Full Accreditation (Eye Care Organisations), and Dental Entry Level Certification — with objective-element tracking, evidence guidance, audit tools, mock drills, and KPI tracking.

Key facts:
- Built for Indian hospitals; pricing from ₹499/month
- Platforms: Web and Android
- Provider: MK Tech — https://accredready.in

## Product

- [AccredReady](https://accredready.in/): Product overview and sign-up
- [NABH Accreditation Software](https://accredready.in/nabh-accreditation-software): Flagship page for hospital NABH prep
- [SHCO Accreditation Software](https://accredready.in/shco-accreditation-software): For small healthcare organizations (under 50 beds)
- [ECO Accreditation Software](https://accredready.in/eco-accreditation-software): For eye care organisations
- [NABH ELC Software](https://accredready.in/nabh-elc-software): For Entry Level Certification
